title: SORT BY RARITY FOLLOWS THE COLOURS
why: Found by the whole-game bug hunt of 2026-10-08. A gun in the stash wears the colour of its tier: the Longshot is gold, the Marksman Rifle purple, the Magnum blue. But SORT: RARITY ordered guns by an older rarity kept for prices, so the gold Longshot sorted below every purple item, the purple Marksman Rifle sat among the blues, and the blue Magnum and Burst Carbine among the greens. The sort now uses the colour each cell shows.
now: Stash SORT RARITY now orders guns by the rarity colour they show.
